recap.headline: 曼联 0–1 雷克瑟姆
recap.summary: 曼联主场以 0–1 不敌雷克瑟姆。本场进球：Sam Smith（39'）。比赛在Helsinki Olympic Stadium进行。

goals.name: Sam Smith
goals.text: Goal! Manchester United 0, Wrexham 1. Sam Smith (Wrexham) right footed shot from the right side of the six yard box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Lewis O'Brien.

recap.headline: 曼联 5–0 罗森博格
recap.summary: 曼联客场以 5–0 战胜罗森博格。本场进球：Shea Lacey（31'）、约书亚·齐尔克泽（56'）、Jacob Devaney（63'）、哈里·阿马斯（72'）、Ethan Williams（84'）。比赛在Lerkendal Stadion进行。

goals.name: Shea Lacey
goals.text: Goal! Rosenborg 0, Manchester United 1. Shea Lacey (Manchester United) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.

goals.name: Joshua Zirkzee
goals.text: Goal! Rosenborg 0, Manchester United 2. Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.

goals.name: Jacob Devaney
goals.text: Goal! Rosenborg 0, Manchester United 3. Jacob Devaney (Manchester United) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal.

goals.name: Harry Amass
goals.text: Goal! Rosenborg 0, Manchester United 4. Harry Amass (Manchester United) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.

goals.name: Ethan Williams
goals.text: Goal! Rosenborg 0, Manchester United 5. Ethan Williams (Manchester United) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.

recap.headline: 曼联 2–1 马德里竞技
recap.summary: 曼联主场以 2–1 战胜马德里竞技。本场进球：Arnau Ortiz（5'）、布莱恩·姆伯莫（53'）、布莱恩·姆伯莫（74'）。比赛在Friends Arena进行。

goals.name: Arnau Ortiz
goals.text: Goal! Manchester United 0, Atletico Madrid 1. Arnau Ortiz (Atletico Madrid) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Koke following a corner.

goals.name: Bryan Mbeumo
goals.text: Goal! Manchester United 1, Atletico Madrid 1. Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) converts the penalty with a left footed shot to the bottom left corner.

goals.name: Bryan Mbeumo
goals.text: Goal! Manchester United 2, Atletico Madrid 1. Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner.

recap.headline: 曼联 1–1 巴黎圣日耳曼
recap.summary: 曼联客场以 1–1 战平巴黎圣日耳曼。本场进球：Ibrahim Mbaye（2'）、布莱恩·姆伯莫（32'）。比赛在Ullevi Stadium进行。

goals.name: Ibrahim Mbaye
goals.text: Goal! Paris Saint Germain 1, Manchester United 0. Ibrahim Mbaye (Paris Saint Germain) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Dro Fernández with a cross.

goals.name: Bryan Mbeumo
goals.text: Goal! Paris Saint Germain 1, Manchester United 1. Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Amad Diallo.
